title: warehouse.sources: one source's schema in the shared warehouse and the views agents read with source_new (apps-mcp serves the warehouse's read tools). Names are SQL identifiers; nothing here is raw SQL.

schema.description: the source's own schema, written by this module alone (src_meta is the warehouse's)

about.description: its views for warehouse_query's description, e.g. src_x.items / changes

identity.description: <schema>.users (user_id, email, display_name, handle, is_bot) feeds the cross-source people links

time.description: the column a first read looks back a day on

channel.description: the column the channels filter matches

repo.description: the column the repos filter matches

project.description: the column the projects filter matches

tsv.description: has a tsv column for the full-text q

exclude.description: rows whose column holds this value are not new work (source_new leaves them out)
